content: आश्व {%a.%} (-श्वी|{%f.%}) [अश्वस्येदम् अण्] .²1 Belonging to or coming from a horse, equestrian; आश्वं कफहरं मूत्रं कृमिदद्रुषु शस्यते <ls>Suśr.</ls> .²2 Drawn by horses (as a chariot). .{@-श्वम्@} .²1 A number of horses. .²2 A chariot drawn by horses. .²3 The state or action of a horse (अश्वस्य भावः कर्म वा <ls>Sk.</ls>).
